Notes

  • If a State Public Holiday falls on a weekly rest day, the following day shall be a public holiday and if such following day is already a public holiday, then the subsequent day shall be a public holiday.
  • If a Public Holiday falls on a Saturday, then that Saturday is considered as a public holiday and shall not be replaced with any other day.
